id.description: The unique ID of this synonym set.

organizationName.description: The Organization that owns this resource. Immutable after creation.

name.description: Resource name (letters, digits, underscores, must start with a letter). Combined with organizationName to form the qualified name '{organizationName}-{name}'. Immutable after creation.

definition.description: Required. The full OpenSearch token filter definition as a JSON object string. Must include a 'type' of 'synonym' or 'synonym_graph' ('synonym_graph' is recommended — see the OpenSearch docs for why). All other parameters (expand, lenient, format, updateable, etc.) are passthrough — supply them as OpenSearch documents them. AOSS NOTE: file-based parameters like 'synonyms_path' are rejected at create/update time (AOSS Serverless does not support file uploads). Supply the synonym list inline via the 'synonyms' array using OpenSearch's native syntax: 'a, b, c' for equivalent, 'a, b => c, d' for explicit.

etag.description: Synapse Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) value. Send the etag from a GET back on update; a mismatch returns 409.

createdBy.description: ID of the user that created this resource.

modifiedOn.description: When this resource was last modified.

modifiedBy.description: ID of the user that last modified this resource.
